dataset.title: Secondary data analysis project data (RISE, iWATCH, NHANES cohorts)
dataset.description: This secondary data analysis project will analyze deidentified data from 48,218 participants from eight studies and the publicly available NHANES cohorts (wrist NHANES 2011-2014; hip/counts-NHANES 2003-2006). The studies include (i) the RISE Study, (ii) the SOL-VIDA Study, (iii) the iWATCH Study, (iv) the MOCA Study, (v) the PHASE Study, (vi) the AusDiab Study, (vii) the ACT Study, and (viii) the WHISH accelerometer sub-study. Sufficient data from those datasets will be preserved to enable sharing to validate and replicate research findings described in the Aims with those datasets only. The final dataset of data from the RISE study, the iWATCH study, and NHANES cohorts will be de-identified. It will be deposited into the UC San Diego Library Data repository along with study protocols, code, and models for public use.
